newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Resources to redeem debt due 2006.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Resources to redeem debt due 2006.

text.p: Equitable Resources Inc recently announced it will redeem on February 20, 1997 all of its outstanding 9-1/2 percent convertible subordinated debentures due January 15, 2006 at full principal plus interest.
Total principal of debentures outstanding is $527,000, according to Equitable Resources.
Holders may also convert the debentures into common stock of Equitable Resources at a conversion price of $11.0617 per share, or 90.4 shares per $1,000 principal amount.
The right to convert debentures will terminate at the close of business on the redemption date.
Debentures converted into common stock may be entitled to a dividend payable March 1, 1997, the company said. The record date for the March 1 dividend is February 13, 1997.
